key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil surge pressured miners and banks (BHP.AX, CBA.AX, NAB.AX)
WTI crude broke $100, triggering a 30c fuel price rise in Australia and stoking inflation concerns
AUD smashed on growth scare; iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating the rate path
Australia softened gas reservation rules (Santos/Santos.AX), easing Asian supply fears but drawing political criticism
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices crashing while affordable segment and first-home buyers surge
Gold underperforming ('gold schmould') despite geopolitical tensions; small-cap miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) outperforming
Chinese inflation soaring and geopolitical friction (Arctic shipping, ambassador warnings) adding external risk

sectors.trend: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) under pressure. Small-cap gold and battery-tech names (PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, Critical Resources) showing relative strength. Canaccord-led cap raises signal capital-raising stress in mid-tier miners.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners face margin compression on iron ore; rotate into gold/battery-tech small caps. Cap raises dilute equity holders—caution on mid-tier names.

sectors.trend: Banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) tumbling on rate-rise fears and bond yield surge. RBA rental inflation concern complicates easing expectations. Superannuation policy debate (One Nation, early access) adds political risk.
sectors.implications: NIM pressure if rates stay elevated; credit cycle risk if housing corrects further. Super policy changes could alter fund flows.

sectors.trend: WTI broke $100; Australia softened gas reservation rules, easing Asian LNG supply fears. Santos.AX benefits from policy shift but political backlash ('Albo sells out gas reservation'). Fuel prices rising 30c.
sectors.implications: Positive for Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, and upstream E&P. Higher fuel costs hit transport and consumer discretionary.

sectors.trend: Woolworths (WES.AX) caught raising 'family staple' prices during a Price Freeze promotion—reputational risk. Women's clothing chain closing 177 stores signals consumer spending stress. Businesses 'fear for their future.'
sectors.implications: Consumer confidence deteriorating; WES.AX and WOW.AX face margin and sentiment pressure. Defensive staples still preferred over discretionary.

sectors.trend: Housing prices crashing at high end; affordable segment resilient. RBA worried about rental inflation. NZ five-year correction still running. Property chiefs calling for more migrants to build supply.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPG.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals—rental inflation supports yields but occupancy risk rises. High-end residential developers under pressure.

sectors.trend: Limited ASX-specific headlines. Small-cap tech (Neurizon, Iondrive) in ASX runners. US healthcare (Medtronic, UnitedHealth) showing resilience. HIVE/BUZZ HPC AI cloud expansion noted.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains a defensive anchor. Small-cap tech speculative; AI cloud theme gaining traction but unproven at scale.

key_themes: Oil surge and rate fears driving broad ASX selloff ($90bn wipeout)
Iron ore structural weakness vs. gold/battery-tech rotation
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare
Housing market bifurcation: luxury crash vs. affordable resilience
Gas policy shift (Santos) reshaping energy landscape
Chinese inflation and geopolitical friction as external risk
Consumer spending stress: price freezes breached, store closures
Superannuation policy populism vs. fiscal prudence debate

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike ($100+ WTI) driving inflation and rate expectations higher
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour downstream refiners over upstream; monitor OPEC+ output decisions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price 'bloodletting' compressing mining margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and battery-tech small caps

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness and growth scare triggering capital outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight export-oriented and USD-revenue earners; use AUD hedges on foreign allocations

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy dilemma: rental inflation vs. growth slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; favour rate-sensitive REITs cautiously; avoid over-leveraged property

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Chinese inflation surge and geopolitical friction (Arctic shipping, ambassador warnings)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from China-exposed commodity flows; monitor PRC trade data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing correction deepening, especially high-end segment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid luxury residential developers; favour affordable-housing REITs and construction names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy upstream (Santos, Woodside) on gas policy shift and oil surge
opportunities.rationale: Softened gas reservation rules support Santos.AX pricing; $100 oil lifts upstream margins

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and battery-tech small caps amid iron ore weakness
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting vs. relative strength in PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Critical Resources

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare (CSL) as portfolio anchor amid volatility
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX insulated from commodity/rate cycles; US healthcare peers showing resilience

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure (BHP, RIO, FMG)
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting underway; margin compression likely through Q1 2027

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank weightings pending RBA clarity on rate path
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-rise fears and rental inflation create NIM uncertainty; housing correction risk to credit

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour USD-revenue earners
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; USD-linked miners and exporters benefit from weakness

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil above $100 and rate fears cap upside. Iron ore weakness drags materials. RBA rental inflation commentary keeps rate-cut hopes muted. Expect volatility around $90bn-level support. Small-cap gold/battery names may outperform.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots. Housing correction (especially high-end) may create value in construction and affordable REITs. Gas policy shift supports Santos/Woodside structurally. Iron ore recovery uncertain; diversification into battery metals and gold preferred. Super policy changes could redirect fund flows.

Santos.AX and WDS.AX share price post-policy
Housing price indices (SQM, CoreLogic) by segment
WES.AX and WOW.AX consumer pricing actions
